place.en: Chending Temple · The herb garden · That year

setup.zh: 马小宝告到执事房：官丹卖了。周衡定下日子——端午辰时，正殿前，当众验封；封条动过，搜铺，搜身。你那道封条，是去年拿米汤粘回去的。
setup.en: Ma Xiaobao has gone to the stewards' office: the temple pill was sold. Zhou Heng has set the day — the Dragon Boat festival, the hour of the dragon, before the main hall, the seal inspected in public; if the seal has been touched, your bunk is searched and so are you. That seal is the one you pasted back with rice water last year.

recap.zh: 端午验封，那一角在你拇指底下翘了一翘，你焐住了；周衡记下「验封。完好。」，又问了一句孙二狗那颗丹几道纹——「我看了」。入秋，丹田那片湖满得往外漾——九层圆满。
recap.en: At the Dragon Boat inspection the corner lifted under your thumb and you held it down with your own warmth; Zhou Heng wrote "Seal inspected. Intact." — and asked how many rings Sun Ergou's pill had: "I looked." In autumn the lake in your dantian brimmed over — the peak of layer nine.

zh: 米汤糊的窗纸，过不了黄梅天。
en: Dragon Boat, the hour of the dragon, before the main hall: the seal.
Rice-water paste never outlasts the plum rains.
Qingming, Dragon Boat, the dog days, autumn.

story.zh:
马小宝去钱掌柜的摊子上一押三十两，押了七回，连一颗一道纹的也没押着。押到第七回，他不押了。他去了执事房。

「周师兄，」他当着一屋子领灵石的人道，「沈小满那颗官丹，卖了。钱掌柜这辈子，除了腊八那一文，没开过头彩，这是他自己赌咒说的。一个练气二层，拿什么换来一包一包的丹送人？他是拿观主赐的丹，跟钱掌柜换的。」

周衡的笔停了。官丹上了他的账，丢了、卖了，都是他账上一个窟窿。他把小满叫了来，道：「官丹的封，是观主的印。要验，得拿正殿的印模来对。印模在观主手里，观主闭关，端午出关。」他在账簿上记了一行：**端午辰时，正殿前，验封。**记完了，又把观规念了一遍，念得跟念账一样平：「封条若是动过，是私揭官封。搜铺，搜身，交戒律堂。」

马小宝笑了：「搜身好。」

从那天起，马小宝那几个跟班轮着班跟他：他挑水，井边便有人洗手；他上茅房，隔壁便有人蹲着。离端午，还有两个多月。

这一年，周衡的残株一个月一篮，一篮进炉，出来的都是九转聚气丹，一个月一颗。

那几个月里，最难的倒不是修炼，是装。

一个人一天比一天耳聪目明，走起路来一天比一天轻，偏要在人前一天比一天笨，这比挑水劈柴还累。
story.en:
Ma Xiaobao went to Shopkeeper Qian's stall and staked thirty taels a time, seven times, and did not win so much as a one-ring pill. After the seventh, he stopped. He went to the stewards' office.

"Brother Zhou," he said, before a roomful of people come for their spirit stones, "Shen Xiaoman's temple pill — he sold it. Shopkeeper Qian has never paid out a top prize in his life except that one copper at Laba; he swore it himself. A layer-two boy — what does he trade for packet after packet of pills to give away? He traded the pill the Abbot gave him, to Shopkeeper Qian."

Zhou Heng's brush stopped. The temple pill was on his books; lost or sold, it was a hole in his accounts. He sent for Xiaoman and said: "The seal on a temple pill is the Abbot's stamp. To check it, it must be laid against the stamp mould in the main hall. The mould is in the Abbot's hands; the Abbot is in seclusion, and comes out at the Dragon Boat festival." He wrote a line in the ledger: **Dragon Boat, hour of the dragon, before the main hall: seal inspection.** Then he recited the temple rule, as flat as reading out an account: "If the seal has been touched, that is breaking a temple seal. The bunk is searched, the body is searched, and the matter goes to the Hall of Discipline."

Ma Xiaobao smiled. "Searching the body — good."

From that day Ma Xiaobao's hangers-on took turns following him: when he drew water, someone was washing his hands at the well; when he went to the latrine, someone was squatting next door. The Dragon Boat festival was a little over two months off.

That year Zhou Heng's culls came a basket a month, and every basket went into the furnace and came out a nine-turn qi pill — one a month.

In those months the hardest thing was not the cultivating. It was the pretending.

To hear sharper and see clearer by the day, to walk lighter by the day, and yet to be clumsier by the day in front of people — that was more tiring than carrying water and splitting wood.

exits.means: the spring month: burns paper for his grandfather and eats that month's pill

story.zh:
练气六层是在清明。

外公的坟在镇上，他去不了，便在后山寻了一块向着蒙山的石头，把一沓黄纸点着了，念着他娘教的口诀，念到「五居中央」，纸烧完了，灰飞起来，打着旋儿往山下去，他丹田里那口水缸，水面又往上涨了一截。

清明过后，雨便没停过。柴房的墙根返了潮，饭桶的铜肚子上，也结了一层细细的水珠。一天夜里，等跟班的鼾声起了，他摸进柴房，把玉盒子掏出来，就着蜡烛一照，心便沉了：去年拿米汤粘回去的那一角，翘起来了，翘得像一只狗耳朵，翘起的地方，还长了一点灰毛。

他娘说过：米汤糊的窗纸，过不了黄梅天。

第二天傍晚，他去药园东角寻阿禾。

小满蹲在她旁边，问：「潮了的东西，怎么弄干，又不发黄？」

阿禾没抬头：「晾，不能烤。种子返了潮，埋进草木灰里，灰吃潮气，不吃颜色。」她顿了一顿，「埋严实。露一个角，就白埋了。」

她没问他要弄干什么。

当夜他去伙房讨了一簸箕灶灰，把玉盒子连封条埋了进去，塞回饭桶肚里。往后每隔几夜，他便掏出来照一照：那只狗耳朵一夜比一夜低，灰毛拿针尖剔干净了，可到了五月初，它还是翘着一根头发丝那么高，怎么也趴不下去。
story.en:
Qi Condensation layer six came at Qingming.

Grandfather's grave was in the town and he could not go, so he found a rock on the back hill facing Mengshan, set a stack of yellow paper alight, and recited the formula his mother had taught him; as he reached "five in the middle", the paper burned out, the ash flew up and spun away down the mountain, and the water in the great jar of his dantian rose another notch.

After Qingming the rain never stopped. The woodshed walls sweated at the foot, and even the Rice Tub's bronze belly beaded with fine drops of water. One night, when the hanger-on's snoring had started, he slipped into the woodshed, took out the jade box, held it to the candle, and his heart sank: the corner he had pasted back with rice water last year had lifted, curled up like a dog's ear, with a little grey fur of mould where it rose.

His mother used to say: window paper pasted with rice water never outlasts the plum rains.

The next evening he went to find A-He at the east corner of the herb garden.

Xiaoman squatted beside her and asked: "Something that's got damp — how do you dry it without it yellowing?"

A-He didn't look up. "Air it, don't bake it. When seed gets damp you bury it in wood ash — the ash eats the damp, not the colour." She paused. "Bury it right in. Leave one corner out and you've buried it for nothing."

She didn't ask what he wanted to dry.

That night he begged a dustpan of stove ash from the kitchen, buried the jade box in it, seal and all, and put it back in the Rice Tub's belly. Every few nights after that he took it out and held it to the light: the dog's ear sat lower each night, and the grey fuzz he picked clean with a needle point, but early in the fifth month it still stood up a hair's breadth, and would not lie down.

exits.means: the early-summer month: the public seal inspection — he holds the lifting corner down with his thumb; then the festival dumpling, the next layer

refuse.en: One season at a time: finish the one before first.

story.zh:
端午前五天劈柴，他劈得兴起，忘了数，一斧头下去，那根碗口粗的柴连着底下的木墩子一齐裂成了两半。他愣了一愣，赶紧捂着手腕叫唤，说木墩子本来就有一道缝。伙房大娘瞧着那木墩子，又瞧着他，道：「这墩子我用了快二十年。」小满道：「所以老了嘛。」窗外头一个跟班撒腿便跑。

那天晚饭，马小宝隔着三张桌子，冲他伸出一只巴掌，五个指头，一个一个往回扳。

端午那天，下着毛毛雨。正殿前的廊下围了半个外门。一个道童捧出印模来，周衡把玉盒子举到廊檐底下，拿印模往大印上一扣，一丝不差。

他把玉盒递还给小满：「拿稳了。」转身去翻观主的印簿，对这一颗丹是哪一天封的。

小满捧着玉盒，拇指压在那一角上。雨气从廊檐外头漫进来，他觉得拇指底下，那只狗耳朵轻轻地，又抬了一抬。他不敢动，也不敢使灵力——一个练气二层的人，手上冒不出热气来。他只是压着，拿自己手上那点热，一点一点地焐。马小宝就站在三步开外，眼睛盯着的，正是他那只拇指。

周衡合上印簿，接过玉盒，拿指甲顺着封条的四条边，一寸一寸刮过去。刮到那一角，指甲停了一停，比别处多停了一眨眼。他的眼睛在小满那只拇指上落了一落——拇指肚上压出了一道红印子。

周衡在账簿上记了一行：**验封。完好。**

马小宝的脸，青一阵，白一阵，挤出人堆走了。人散了，周衡却叫住小满，把账簿往胳膊底下一夹，低声问了一句：「孙二狗那颗聚气丹，几道纹？」

小满道：「他吃得急，没顾上看。」

周衡看着他，道：「我看了。」

七层是在端午，一口枣核正卡在嗓子眼里。
story.en:
Five days before the Dragon Boat festival he was splitting firewood, got carried away and forgot to count: one stroke of the axe, and a log as thick as a bowl split in two together with the chopping block under it. He froze a moment, then clutched his wrist and yelped that the block had had a crack in it all along. The kitchen aunt looked at the block, then at him: "I've used that block nearly twenty years." Xiaoman said: "That's why it was old." Outside the window, one of the hangers-on took to his heels.

At supper that night Ma Xiaobao, three tables away, held up one hand at him, five fingers, and folded them down one by one.

On the day of the Dragon Boat festival a fine rain was falling. Half the outer court crowded the gallery before the main hall. A Daoist boy carried out the stamp mould; Zhou Heng raised the jade box under the eaves and set the mould on the great stamp — not a hair out.

He handed the jade box back to Xiaoman — "Hold it steady" — and turned to leaf through the Abbot's seal register for the day this pill had been sealed.

Xiaoman held the jade box, his thumb pressed on that corner. The damp of the rain drifted in under the eaves, and under his thumb he felt the dog's ear lift, gently, once more. He dared not move, nor use his spirit power — a man of layer two has no heat to give off through his hands. He only pressed, and warmed it, little by little, with the warmth of his own hand. Ma Xiaobao stood three paces off, and what his eyes were fixed on was that thumb.

Zhou Heng closed the register, took the jade box, and ran his fingernail along the four edges of the seal, inch by inch. At that corner the nail paused — one blink longer than anywhere else. His eyes rested a moment on Xiaoman's thumb: a red mark pressed into the pad of it.

Zhou Heng wrote a line in the ledger: **Seal inspected. Intact.**

Ma Xiaobao's face went green, then white, and he pushed out through the crowd. When the people had gone, Zhou Heng called Xiaoman back, tucked the ledger under his arm, and asked, low: "Sun Ergou's qi pill — how many rings?"

Xiaoman said: "He ate it in a hurry. Didn't stop to look."

Zhou Heng looked at him and said: "I looked."

Seven came at the Dragon Boat festival, with a date stone stuck in his throat.

label.en: The dog days · Cooling off on the low wall

exits.means: the hot month: nights on the herb-garden wall with A-He and Sun Ergou

refuse.zh: 一季一季来：先过了前头那一季。
refuse.en: One season at a time: finish the one before first.

story.zh:
八层是在伏天里，热得柴房里的耗子都搬了家。

伏天里最热的那几夜，药园巡完了，三个人常坐在药园的矮墙上乘凉：小满，阿禾，孙二狗。

小满问：「你想叫什么？」孙二狗想了半天，道：「……还叫二狗吧。我娘叫惯了。」

小满没笑。阿禾也没笑。墙底下的小狰翻了个身，打了个响鼻。
story.en:
Eight came in the dog days, so hot the rats moved out of the woodshed.

On the hottest nights of the dog days, when the garden round was done, the three of them would sit on the herb garden's low wall to cool off: Xiaoman, A-He, Sun Ergou.

Xiaoman asked: "What would you like to be called?" Sun Ergou thought for a long time and said: "…Ergou still. My mother's used to it."

Xiaoman did not laugh. Nor did A-He. Under the wall the little Zheng rolled over and snorted.

label.en: Autumn · The peak of layer nine

exits.means: the autumn month: the lake brims over, the peak of Qi Condensation; his master calls him up the cliff

refuse.zh: 一季一季来：先过了前头那一季。
refuse.en: One season at a time: finish the one before first.

story.zh:
到得入秋，丹田里那口水缸满得往外直漾，吸进去一口灵气，便溢出来一口，再也添不进去了——褚先生管这个，叫作「九层圆满」。

八月里，瞿老叫他上了一趟崖顶。
story.en:
By autumn the great jar in his dantian was brimming over: breathe in one breath of spirit and one spilled out; nothing more would go in — Master Chu called this "the peak of layer nine".

In the eighth month, Old Qu called him up to the clifftop.
